DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 現在、この乗り場から先の区間は運転を見合わせています。どちらまで行かれる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Service on the section beyond this boarding point is currently suspended. Where are you planning to go?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 病院の面会へ向かっています。掲示に三十分とありますが、三十分後には必ず乗れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 病院面会へ向かい掲示の三十分後に必ず乗れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to visit someone at the hospital. The notice says thirty minutes. Does that mean I will definitely be able to board in thirty minutes?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are going to a hospital visit, and ask whether you can definitely board after the thirty minutes shown on the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 掲示は確認にかかる時間の目安で、運転再開を約束する時刻ではありません。更新後の案内をお待ちいただくことになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: The notice is an estimate of the time needed for checks, not a promised time for service to resume. You would need to wait for updated information.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 面会の約束まで四十分なので、ここで待つか迷っています。動いている区間だけ乗って近づけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 約束まで四十分なので動く区間だけ乗って近づけるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: My hospital visit is in forty minutes, so I am unsure whether to wait here. Could I ride just the section that is operating to get closer?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your appointment is in forty minutes, and ask whether riding only the operating section would get you closer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今いる乗り場からは、その区間へ直通できません。移動する場合は、別の交通手段を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: You cannot go directly to that section from this boarding point. If you travel elsewhere, please check another form of transport.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 切符はまだ買っていません。歩いて途中まで行くより、タクシー乗り場を探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未購入の切符を買わずタクシー乗り場を探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not bought a ticket yet. Rather than walking part of the way, I would like to find the taxi stand.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not bought a ticket and will look for the taxi stand instead of buying one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内図の出口側に乗り場があります。車の待ち時間や病院までの所要時間は、運転手へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a taxi stand on the exit side of this map. Please ask a driver about the wait for a taxi and the journey time to the hospital.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。運転が再開したら、ここを離れていても案内を見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗り場を離れてから運転再開案内を確認できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. If service resumes after I leave here, will I still be able to see the announcement?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can check announcements about service resuming after leaving the boarding point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 更新情報の確認先はこちらに載っています。移動中に見る際は、歩きながら画面を見ないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: The place to check updates is listed here. If you check while traveling, do not look at your screen while walking.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認先を控えます。まず病院へ遅れるかもしれないと連絡し、乗り場でタクシーの所要時間を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 病院へ遅延可能性を連絡してからタクシー所要時間を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note down where to check. First, I will tell the hospital I may be late, then ask at the taxi stand about the journey time.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell the hospital you may be late before asking about the taxi journey time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内図をお持ちください。どうぞお気をつけて。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the map. Take care, and have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 料理の量で迷われていますか。麺の量が違うメニューもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you unsure about the portion size? We also have menu options with different amounts of noodles.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕飯まであまり時間がないので、麺は少なめで野菜は普通の量にしたいです。そのように頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夕飯が近いので麺少なめと野菜通常量が可能か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is not much time until dinner, so I would like fewer noodles but the normal amount of vegetables. Could I order it that way?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that dinner is soon, and ask whether you can have fewer noodles with the normal amount of vegetables. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小さいサイズは全体の量が減ります。麺だけ減らせるかは、厨房へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: The small size reduces the overall portion. I will check with the kitchen whether we can reduce just the noodles.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 野菜も減るなら小さいサイズはやめます。麺だけ減らしても、値段は普通サイズと同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 野菜まで減る小サイズを避け麺のみ減量の価格を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: If the vegetables would be reduced as well, I will not choose the small size. If you reduce only the noodles, is the price still the same as the regular size?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you do not want a small size if it also reduces the vegetables, and ask the price for reducing only the noodles. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認しました。この店舗では麺を減らすことはできますが、価格は普通サイズのままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have checked. At this shop, we can reduce the noodles, but the price remains the regular-size price.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それで構いません。野菜が多いのはよいのですが、炒めた野菜が熱すぎないか少し心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通常価格を了承し出来たて野菜の熱さを心配すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: That is fine. I do not mind plenty of vegetables, but I am a little worried that the stir-fried vegetables might be too hot.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept the regular price and express concern about how hot the freshly cooked vegetables will be. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出来たてなので熱くなります。温度を下げて提供することはお約束できませんが、取り分ける小皿をご用意できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: They will be hot because they are freshly cooked. We cannot promise to serve them at a lower temperature, but we can provide a small plate for separating portions.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小皿をお願いします。急いで全部食べず、少しずつ冷まして食べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 急がず冷ましながら食べるため取り分ける皿を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please bring a small plate. I would like to let small portions cool as I eat, rather than rushing to eat everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a small plate so that you can let portions cool and eat without rushing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承りました。普通サイズの価格で麺少なめ、野菜は通常量、小皿付きです。この内容でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. That is fewer noodles, the normal amount of vegetables, and a small plate, at the regular-size price. Is that correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、その内容で注文します。小皿へ取り分けて、自分で温度を確かめながら食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 麺少なめ野菜通常量で小皿付きと確認し自分で温度を見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will order that. I will transfer portions to the small plate and check the temperature myself as I eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm fewer noodles, the normal amount of vegetables, and a small plate, and say that you will check the temperature yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご注文を承りました。出来上がりまでお待ちください。ありがとうございます。それでは失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your order is confirmed. Please wait until it is ready. Thank you. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日も測量補助です。北側の測点へ行く前に、朝の通路確認は済みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are assisting with surveying again today. Before going to the survey point on the north side, have you completed the morning route check?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日使った道に板が積まれていました。一本ずつ動かせば通れそうですが、先に片付けてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日の道に板が積まれ自分で一本ずつ動かしてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: Boards have been stacked on the path we used yesterday. It looks passable if I move them one at a time. May I clear them away first?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that boards are stacked on yesterday's path, and ask whether you may move them one by one yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 自分の判断で資材を動かしてはいけません。仮置きの担当が位置を確認します。今は手を触れずに待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not move materials at your own discretion. The person responsible for temporary storage will check their position. For now, wait without touching them.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。測量の道具を持ったまま、どこで待てば作業の邪魔になりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 道具を持ったまま作業の邪魔にならない待機場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. Where can I wait with the surveying equipment without getting in the way of the work?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask where you can wait with the equipment without getting in the way of the work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 詰所前の待機場所へ置いてください。資材の横や車両通路では待たないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Put it in the waiting area in front of the site office. Do not wait beside the materials or in the vehicle route.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 北側へ行く別の道はありますか。昨日見た仮設の足場を通るのはどうでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 北側へ行く道として仮設足場を使えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is there another route to the north side? What about using the temporary scaffolding I saw yesterday?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the temporary scaffolding can be used as a route to the north side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その足場は測量担当の通路ではありません。西側の安全通路を使います。入口まで私が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: That scaffolding is not a walkway for the surveying team. We will use the safe walkway on the west side. I will guide you to its entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 西側を使うなら、今日の測量範囲も変わりますか。北側の印まで行ってよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 西側経路に変えても北側の印まで測量してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: If we use the west side, will today's survey area change too? I want to check whether I may go as far as the mark on the north side.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may still survey up to the north-side mark when switching to the west-side route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 測量範囲は北側の指定した印までで変わりません。ただし柵を越える範囲は対象外です。出発前に図面で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: The survey area remains unchanged, up to the designated mark on the north side. However, the area beyond the fence is excluded. We will check the drawing before setting off.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資材には触らず詰所前へ道具を置きます。図面で範囲を確認してから、西側の通路を案内してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資材に触れず道具を置き図面確認後に西側経路案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will leave the materials untouched and put the equipment in front of the site office. After we check the area on the drawing, please show me the west-side route.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not touch the materials and will put the equipment down, then ask to be shown the west-side route after checking the drawing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その手順で進めます。まず待機場所へどうぞ。安全を優先しましょう。それでは、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will follow that procedure. Please go to the waiting area first. Let's put safety first. Take care as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座開設のご相談ですね。どのようなお支払いに使う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss opening an account. What payments do you plan to use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃の引落し用です。管理会社からこの銀行を指定されましたが、まだ日本へ来て二か月です。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃引落しで銀行指定があり来日二か月と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: For automatic rent payments. The management company specified this bank, but I only came to Japan two months ago.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the account is for automatic rent payments, that the bank was specified, and that you arrived in Japan two months ago. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本人の状況と取引内容を確認します。日本での住所が分かる書類と、在留カードはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check your circumstances and intended transactions. Do you have documents showing your address in Japan and your residence card?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 在留カードには今の住所があります。働き始めたばかりですが、勤務先の証明も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現住所の在留カードがあり就労開始直後の勤務先証明が必要か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: My residence card shows my current address. I have only just started working. Do I also need proof of employment?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that your residence card has your current address, and ask whether proof of employment is needed when you have just started work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な書類は担当者が確認します。就労状況が分かる資料をお持ちなら、確認の参考になる場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check the required documents. If you have materials showing your employment situation, they may help with the check.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 社員証と雇用契約書があります。家賃の契約は妻の名前なので、私名義の口座でよいかも心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 社員証と契約書を持ち賃貸契約が妻名義なので自分の口座でよいか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an employee ID and an employment contract. The rental contract is in my wife's name, so I am also worried whether an account in my name will be acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have an employee ID and employment contract, and ask whether your own account is acceptable when the rental contract is in your wife's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 引落し口座の名義を誰にできるかは、管理会社へ確認してください。こちらでは賃貸契約の条件を判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check with the management company whose name the debit account can be in. We cannot determine the conditions of your rental contract here.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に管理会社へ聞きます。今は書類を見てもらうだけにして、開設の申請を後日にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理会社へ先に聞くため今日は書類確認だけで申請を後日にできるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask the management company first. Could I just have my documents checked now and apply to open the account another day?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the management company first, and ask whether today's visit can be limited to checking documents with the application left for another day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 事前相談はできます。ただし書類があることだけで開設が決まるわけではありません。利用目的も含め担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: An advance consultation is possible. However, having the documents alone does not mean the account will be opened. The staff member will check your purpose of use and other details.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は事前相談をお願いします。管理会社に私名義でよいか確かめ、指定が合う場合に申請します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 事前相談を受け管理会社が自分名義を認める場合に申請すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please give me an advance consultation today. I will check whether the management company allows an account in my name and apply if that meets its requirements.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will have an advance consultation and apply if the management company accepts an account in your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者へおつなぎします。お持ちの資料をお手元にどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the staff member. Please have the materials you brought ready. Thank you for consulting us. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行のご案内でしょうか。どの列車をお待ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking for service information? Which train are you waiting for?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事の待ち合わせに向かう列車です。朝に保存した画面では十分遅れとなっていますが、今も同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝の保存画面の十分遅れが現在も同じか、利用予定の列車について質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The train I am taking to a work meeting. A screen I saved this morning says it is ten minutes late. Is that still the case?
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the ten-minute delay shown on a screen saved this morning still applies to the train you plan to take. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その画面の時刻を拝見しますね。構内表示のほうが新しく、こちらでは到着時刻は調整中と出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me look at the time on that screen. The station display is more recent, and it says the arrival time is being adjusted.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 保存した情報のままではいけませんね。今分かるのは、到着の見込みがまだ出ていないということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保存情報が古いと理解し、現時点で到着見込みが未定か言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should not keep relying on the saved information. Does that mean there is no arrival estimate available at the moment?
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the saved information is outdated, and restate your understanding that there is currently no arrival estimate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、何分で着くとはお伝えできません。到着の約束があるなら、まず相手へ状況を知らせる方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, we cannot tell you how many minutes until it arrives. If someone is expecting you, one option is to let them know the situation first.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先方には十分遅れるとだけ伝えてしまいました。見込み未定に変わったと連絡し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先方へ十分遅れと伝えたが、見込み未定へ連絡し直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have already told them only that I would be ten minutes late. I will contact them again to say the estimate is now undetermined.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you told the other person about a ten-minute delay but will contact them again to say the estimate is undetermined. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お待ちになる間は更新を確認できます。別の行き方も検討されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check updates while you wait. Would you also consider another route?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: すぐ移動を決めず、ほかの経路に切り替える前に、今の切符がどう扱われるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 経路変更を決める前に現在の切符の扱いを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not decide to move straight away. Before switching to another route, I would like to ask what happens to my current ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what happens to your current ticket before deciding to change routes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切符の種類と区間を窓口で確認します。代替経路の手配や払戻しが決まったという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The counter will check the ticket type and route. That does not mean alternative travel arrangements or a refund have already been decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 切符を出して相談します。先方の返事を待ちながら、新しい表示も見ておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切符を示して相談し、先方の返答と更新表示を待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show my ticket and ask. While waiting for the other person's reply, I will also watch for new information on the display.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to show your ticket and ask for advice while waiting for the other person's reply and updated display information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表示と切符を別々に確かめる形ですね。向こうの窓口へお進みください。お気をつけて、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: So you will check the display and your ticket separately. Please go to the counter over there. Take care, and have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの紙は見学案内ですね。どの部分が気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: The paper you have is a visitor guide. Which part concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「要予約」とあるので、明日は中に入れないのかと思いました。まだ申込みはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 要予約を入場全体の条件と思い、未申込みで明日入れるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says reservations are required, so I thought I might not be able to go inside tomorrow. I have not applied yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought reservations were required for all entry, and ask whether you can enter tomorrow without having applied. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この行は解説会についてです。建物の一般見学とは別の欄になっています。解説会への参加が目的ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That line is about a guided talk. It is in a different section from general visits to the building. Is attending the talk your purpose?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 展示を自分のペースで見たいだけです。一般見学の欄がどこか、教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 解説会でなく自由な展示見学が目的と述べ、一般見学欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only want to see the exhibits at my own pace. Could you show me where the section for general visits is?
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to see the exhibits freely rather than attend the guided talk, and ask where the general-visit section is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらです。ただ、この紙は先月のものなので、明日の開いている範囲は新しい案内と照らす必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here it is. However, this paper is from last month, so we need to compare it with current information to see which areas will be open tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 予約の有無だけでは決められないのですね。古い紙でなく、明日の日付に合う案内を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先月の紙でなく明日の日付に対応する案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it is not just a question of whether a reservation is needed. I would like information that applies to tomorrow's date, rather than an old paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for information that applies to tomorrow's date rather than last month's paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 電話番号はこの問い合わせ欄にあります。施設へ電話する際は、展示見学の予定と訪問日を分けて伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The phone number is in this inquiry section. When calling the facility, explain your plan to see the exhibits and your visit date as separate points.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 解説会ではなく一般見学で、明日行く予定と話します。立ち入れる展示室も、そのときに聞けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 明日の一般見学と伝える内容を言い直し、見学可能な展示室も聞くか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will say that I plan to go tomorrow for a general visit, not the guided talk. Should I also ask then which exhibition rooms I can enter?
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Restate that you will explain tomorrow's general visit, and ask whether to check which exhibition rooms can be visited as well. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。時間と見学可能な範囲の二点を確認すると、予定を組みやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Checking both the hours and the areas open to visitors will make it easier to plan.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この番号を控えます。回答が出るまでは同行者に入館できると言い切らないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 問い合わせ番号を控え、回答前に同行者へ入館を約束しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note down this number. Until I get an answer, I will not tell my companion definitively that we can enter.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will note down the inquiry number and will not promise your companion entry before receiving an answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでしたら行き違いを防げますね。確認が済みましたら、どうぞ見学をお楽しみください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: That should help prevent misunderstandings. Once you have checked, enjoy your visit. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 参拝を終えられたところでしょうか。受付に御用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you just finished paying your respects? Do you need something at the reception desk?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 参拝は済ませました。御朱印をお願いしたいのですが、帳面を家に置いてきてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 参拝を済ませたが御朱印帳を忘れたので受付へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have finished paying my respects. I would like a goshuin temple or shrine inscription, but I left my inscription book at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain at reception that you have paid your respects but forgot your goshuin inscription book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 帳面へお書きする方法とは別に、この受付では書置きの案内があります。そちらをご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Apart from writing directly in your book, this desk offers information about inscriptions prepared on separate sheets. Would you like to see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 書置きというのは、別の紙に書かれたものを受け取るという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書置きは別紙を受け取る意味か確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Does a separately prepared inscription mean receiving one written on another sheet of paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether a separately prepared inscription means receiving a separate sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。帳面そのものをお渡しするという意味ではありません。ここに見本がございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. It does not mean that we give you the book itself. There is a sample here.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見本で分かりました。持ち帰る途中に折れないよう、受け取ったら袋へ入れてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書置きを折らずに持ち帰るため袋へ入れてよいか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The sample makes it clear. May I put it in a bag after receiving it so that it does not get folded on the way home?
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may put the inscription sheet in a bag to take it home without folding it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、袋に入れてお持ち帰りいただけます。ほかの方が通る所で広げないようにしていただければと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, you may put it in a bag to take home. We ask that you do not spread it out where other people are passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物の整理は通路から離れて行います。この見本を撮る前にも、撮影できるか伺いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物整理を通路外にすると伝え、見本撮影の可否を事前に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will organize my belongings away from the walkway. Before photographing this sample, I would also like to ask whether photography is allowed.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will organize your belongings away from the walkway, and ask in advance whether you may photograph the sample. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この受付では見本の撮影はお控えいただいています。受け取る種類は、文字を指してお伝えいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We ask visitors not to photograph samples at this desk. You can point to the writing to tell us which type you would like.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真は撮りません。こちらの文字の書置きを一枚お願いしたいので、受付の順番を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影せず、文字で示した書置き一枚を希望して順番を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not take a photo. I would like one separate sheet with this writing, so I will wait my turn at reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not take a photo, would like one inscription sheet indicated by its writing, and will wait your turn. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの書置きですね。受付の順に伺いますので、列の最後尾へどうぞ。お参りありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: This separate-sheet inscription, then. We will serve people in order, so please go to the end of the line. Thank you for visiting to pay your respects. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診でしょうか。受付へ伝えておきたい症状はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this your first visit? Are there symptoms you would like reception to know about?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めてです。三日前からせきが出て、昨夜は眠りにくくなりました。いつからと書けばよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: せきは三日前、眠りにくい変化は昨夜で、いつからの記入に迷うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is my first visit. I started coughing three days ago, and last night it became hard to sleep. I am unsure what to write for when it started.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the cough began three days ago, difficulty sleeping started last night, and you are unsure what to write for when it began. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: せきが出始めた時と、眠りにくくなった時を分けて書けます。昨夜からせきが始まったわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can write separately when the cough began and when sleeping became difficult. The cough did not start just last night, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。せきは三日前、眠れないほど気になったのは昨夜です。その二つを別の行に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発症と昨夜の変化を別々の行に書くと具体的に言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct. The cough started three days ago, and last night was when it bothered me so much that I could not sleep. I will write those on separate lines.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Restate specifically that you will write the onset and last night's change on separate lines. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのように経過を伝えてください。現在使っている薬についても、分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please explain the course of your symptoms that way. Do you also have something showing the medicines you are currently using?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 市販の薬の箱を持ってきました。名前を覚えていないので、こちらを見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 市販薬の名前を覚えていないため持参した箱の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought the box of an over-the-counter medicine. I do not remember its name. Could you look at this?
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask someone to check the box you brought because you do not remember the over-the-counter medicine's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱にある名前を確認して、診療側に伝えます。資格確認に使うものと薬の箱は別に出しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the name on the box and tell the clinical staff. Please put out your eligibility-verification documents and the medicine box separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 資格確認の資料はこちらです。問診票の「服用」の意味は、薬を飲むということで合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資格確認資料を示し、服用という語は薬を飲む意味か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here are my eligibility-verification documents. Does the word for taking medication on the questionnaire mean taking medicine by mouth?
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your eligibility-verification documents and ask whether the term for taking medication means taking medicine by mouth. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、ここでは飲んでいる薬についての欄です。分からない名前を推測で書かず、箱を示したことも伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, this field concerns the medicines you take. Rather than guessing a name you do not know, you can also state that you showed us the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 服用欄には箱を持参したと添えます。せきの始まりと昨夜の変化が混ざっていないか、記入後に見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薬箱持参を欄へ添え、記入後に経過の混同がないか確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will add in the medication field that I brought the box. After I fill this out, please check whether I have mixed up the start of the cough with last night's change.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will add that you brought the medicine box, and ask for a check after writing to make sure the symptom timeline is not confused. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入した経過を一緒に読み返しましょう。その後、診療担当へ引き継ぎます。どうぞお大事に。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's read through the course of symptoms you wrote together. Then we will pass it on to the clinical staff. Take care, and please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書のご相談ですね。提出先の依頼文をお持ちでしたら拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about a certificate. If you have the recipient's written request, may I see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋の契約で必要と言われました。このメモには「住所の証明」としかなく、種類が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 賃貸のため住所の証明を求められたが正式な種類が不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told I need it for renting a room. This note only says proof of address, so I do not know what type is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you were asked for proof of address for a rental contract but do not know the official document type. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その言葉だけでは書類を一つに決められません。提出するのはご本人の情報だけでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Those words alone do not identify a single document. Are you submitting only your own information?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私だけなのか、同居する家族の分も必要なのかも聞いていません。申請する前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人だけか同居家族分も必要か未確認で、申請前に確かめたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not asked whether it is only mine or whether my family members living with me are included. I would like to check before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not confirmed whether it is only for you or also for family members living with you, and want to check before applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出先には、書類の正式な名称と、誰についてどの情報が必要かを尋ねると整理できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can clarify matters by asking the recipient for the document's official name and whose information is needed, and which details.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 必要のない家族の情報まで載せたくありません。省けるかどうかも、名前が分かってから窓口で相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不要な家族情報を載せたくないため書類特定後に省略可能項目を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not want to include unnecessary information about my family. Once I know the document's name, can I ask at the counter which details can be omitted?
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not want unnecessary family information included, and ask to discuss omittable details after the document is identified. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、対象の書類が分かれば記載事項を一緒に確認できます。今は用紙を確定せずにおきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Once the document is identified, we can check the information to include together. Let's avoid settling on a form for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 提出先へ「正式名称、本人だけか、必要な記載項目」の三つを電話で聞きます。メモに抜けはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正式名称、本人だけか、記載項目という三点を提出先へ聞くと整理し不足を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will phone the recipient to ask three things: the official name, whether it is only for me, and the required details. Is anything missing from my note?
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: List the three questions for the recipient: the official name, whether only your own information is needed, and the required details; ask whether anything is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その三点で用件は伝わります。回答には、どの書類の話か分かるよう名称を省略せず残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Those three points will convey your question. When recording the answer, do not abbreviate the name, so that it is clear which document is meant.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返答をそのまま書き留めて戻ります。似た名前の証明書を先に取るのはやめておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返答を正確に控えて戻り、似た名前の証明書を先に取得しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write down their answer exactly and return. I will not obtain a certificate with a similar name in advance.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to record the answer accurately and return, without obtaining a similarly named certificate in advance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは回答がそろってからご相談を再開しましょう。お手元の依頼メモをお返しします。お気をつけて、またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's resume the consultation once you have the answers. Here is your request note back. Take care, and please visit us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 折り畳み傘をご覧ですね。通勤用をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at folding umbrellas. Are you looking for one for commuting?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 毎日かばんに入れる傘です。軽いほうにひかれますが、ぬれた後に片付けやすいかも気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通勤かばん用の傘で軽さとぬれた後の片付けやすさを重視すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want an umbrella to keep in my bag every day. I am drawn to the lighter one, but I also care about how easy it is to put away after it gets wet.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that for an umbrella kept in your commuting bag, you value light weight and ease of putting it away after it gets wet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは細い袋、もう一方は口が大きく開く袋です。どちらも、しまう前のお手入れ表示を読んで選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This one has a narrow sleeve, while the other has a sleeve with a wide opening. For either one, you can read the care instructions before storing it and then choose.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 細い袋だと急いで入れにくそうです。口の広いほうの袋を、空の状態で開いてみてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 細い袋は入れにくそうなので口の広い展示袋を開いて試したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: A narrow sleeve looks difficult to put it into quickly. May I open the empty sleeve with the wider opening to try it?
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the narrow sleeve looks hard to use, and ask to open and try the display sleeve with the wider opening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 展示用でお試しいただけます。傘を留める帯の位置も、こちらで見比べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You may try the display sample. You can also compare the positions of the straps that secure the umbrellas here.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この帯なら留めやすいです。ただ、かばんの横ポケットに入るか、畳んだ長さを確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帯は留めやすいが横ポケットに入るか畳んだ長さを知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: This strap is easy to fasten. But I would like to check the folded length to see whether it fits in my bag's side pocket.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the strap is easy to fasten, but you want to know the folded length to see whether it fits in the side pocket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 長さはこの表示にあります。袋に収めた状態でもお試しいただけますので、かばんの寸法と比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The length is shown here. You can also try it inside the sleeve, so please compare it with your bag's dimensions.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 横ポケットには収まらなそうなので、中に入れます。専用袋は別売りではなく、この商品に付いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 横ポケットでなくかばん内に入れると決め、袋が付属するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It does not look like it will fit in the side pocket, so I will put it inside the bag. Is the sleeve included with this product rather than sold separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to put it inside your bag rather than the side pocket, and ask whether the sleeve is included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この商品表示では袋付きです。今ご覧の袋も、その付属品に含まれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The product label says a sleeve is included. The sleeve you are looking at is one of those included accessories.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋付きのこちらにします。軽さの差より出し入れしやすいほうを選び、乾かし方の表示も読んでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 軽さより出し入れを優先して袋付き商品を選び手入れ表示も読むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take this one with the sleeve. I will choose ease of taking it out and putting it away over the difference in weight, and read the drying instructions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you choose the product with a sleeve, prioritizing ease of handling over light weight, and will also read the care instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 毎日扱う場面に合わせて選べましたね。こちらをレジへお持ちください。ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have chosen one to suit everyday use. Please take it to the register. Thank you, and we hope to see you again.
